description.mek_ex.nuclear_control_tank: The casing used in the Nuclear Control Tank multiblock, a structure capable of storing great amounts of fluid and chemicals and radioactive materials.
description.mek_ex.nuclear_control_valve: A valve that can be placed on a Nuclear Control Tank multiblock, allowing for fluids and chemicals and and radioactive materials. to be inserted and extracted via external piping.
description.mek_ex.neutron_activator: A powered and self-radiation chemical activating machine.
description.mek_ex.environmental_radiati: Consumes environmental radiation, stores it safely, and generates energy from the absorbed radiation.
description.mek_ex.antimatter_supercharg: A supercharged coil that increases SPS processing speed fivefold and produces purple lightning.
upgrade.mek_ex.capacity.desc: Increases generator energy storage by 50% per upgrade. Maximum of 4 upgrades.
